    """ Input to this function is a string containing multiple groups of parentheses. Your goal is to
    separate those group into separate strings and return the list of those.
    Separate groups are balanced (each open brace is properly closed) and not nested within each other
    Ignore any spaces in the input string.
    """

Clarification: Each occurrence is treated independently and included separately in the output list, in the order encountered (duplicates are not deduplicated).

Clarification: A group starts where the running depth goes from 0 to 1 (an opening '(') and ends where the depth returns to 0 (the matching ')'); everything in between, however deeply nested, belongs to that one group.
